BackstoryDef.title: City child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the streets and markets of the Imperial City, the gleaming heart of Cyrodiil. Surrounded by merchants, scholars, and legionnaires from birth, [PAWN_pronoun] learned early how to read people and talk [PAWN_possessive] way out of trouble.

BackstoryDef.title: Province child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised on a farm or in a small town in the heartland of Cyrodiil. Hard work and self-reliance came naturally. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up hearing tales of the Legion and dreamed of seeing the Imperial City one day.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion camp child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to an Imperial Legionnaire and spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood moving between garrison postings across Cyrodiil. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to drill before [PAWN_pronoun] could read, and could dismantle a blade before most children could tie their boots.

BackstoryDef.title: Dockside child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up near the wharves of the Imperial City's waterfront district, watching merchant barges unload goods from distant provinces. [PAWN_pronoun] ran errands for traders, learned to spot a forged coin, and knew every back alley before [PAWN_pronoun] was ten.

BackstoryDef.title: Temple oblate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in service to the Nine Divines, sweeping shrine floors and memorizing prayers before [PAWN_pronoun] understood what they meant. The temple taught [PAWN_objective] patience, piety, and how to keep secrets.

BackstoryDef.title: Noble ward
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was fostered to a minor noble house in the Imperial City as a matter of political alliance. [PAWN_pronoun] ate at fine tables, attended private tutors, and never stopped feeling like a guest in someone else's home.

BackstoryDef.title: Estate child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on one of the great Colovian agricultural estates, surrounded by livestock, laborers, and the rhythms of the seasons. [PAWN_pronoun] could ride before [PAWN_pronoun] could write and knew how to break a horse by age twelve.

BackstoryDef.title: Miner's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up near the silver mines of the Colovian Highlands, breathing dust and learning the value of hard labor from birth. [PAWN_pronoun] hauled ore before [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to be paid for it.

BackstoryDef.title: Arcane apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was identified as magically gifted in early childhood and sent to study under an associate member of the Mages Guild. [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] formative years memorizing theory, mixing reagents, and trying not to set anything on fire.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born to a family of traveling merchants and spent [PAWN_possessive] entire childhood on the roads of Cyrodiil. Every city was a temporary home and every stranger a potential customer. [PAWN_pronoun] learned more about people than any school could teach.

BackstoryDef.title: Forest child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the wooded reaches near Chorrol, where hunting was both sport and survival. [PAWN_pronoun] tracked game through the Great Forest before most children had seen beyond their village, and could read the land like a written page.

BackstoryDef.title: Scribe's apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood in the service of an Imperial administrator, copying legal documents and running messages between offices of state. [PAWN_pronoun] could write in four scripts by age nine and knew the layout of every ministry.

BackstoryDef.title: Garrison town child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a town built around an Imperial Legion fort, where the rhythms of military life set the pace of everything. [PAWN_pronoun] watched soldiers drill at dawn, helped [PAWN_possessive] parents sell food and tools to the garrison, and knew the sound of a march-out by age six.

BackstoryDef.title: River child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up along the Niben River, where the waterway was both road and larder. [PAWN_pronoun] fished, poled barges, and listened to the stories of traders drifting through on their way to market. The river taught [PAWN_objective] patience.

BackstoryDef.title: Guild errand-runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran errands for the local Fighters Guild hall from the time [PAWN_pronoun] could carry a message. [PAWN_pronoun] sharpened blades, oiled armor, and eavesdropped on contracts. By the time [PAWN_pronoun] was old enough to join, [PAWN_pronoun] already knew every member by name.

BackstoryDef.title: Alchemist's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised behind the counter of a Nibenean alchemist's shop, surrounded by strange smells and stranger ingredients. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to identify plants and reagents by sight and smell, and developed a taste for careful, methodical work.

BackstoryDef.title: Border child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up near one of Cyrodiil's provincial borders, where the Legion's presence was thin and people settled disputes themselves. [PAWN_pronoun] learned early that self-reliance was not a virtue but a necessity.

BackstoryDef.title: Arena district child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the shadow of the Imperial Arena, where the roar of the crowd was a daily backdrop. [PAWN_pronoun] sneaked into bouts, ran bets between spectators, and idolized the combatants. [PAWN_possessive] heroes were not scholars or senators but the ones who bled and won.

BackstoryDef.title: Mason's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the child of a stonemason who built roads, bridges, and fortifications for the Empire. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up learning how things were put together and developed an instinctive understanding of structure, load, and material.

BackstoryDef.title: Street child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] survived [PAWN_possessive] early years on the streets of a large Imperial city, running with petty thieves and taking what [PAWN_pronoun] needed. [PAWN_pronoun] learned the value of observation, timing, and never drawing attention.

BackstoryDef.title: Blacksmith's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up working the bellows in [PAWN_possessive] parent's smithy, learning metal and fire from the moment [PAWN_pronoun] was strong enough to hold a hammer. Every Legion contract that came through the forge was a lesson in craft and demand.

BackstoryDef.title: Count's household child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up as a servant's child within the household of an Imperial Count, attending to the needs of the nobility and observing the machinery of governance from below. [PAWN_pronoun] learned courtesy, discretion, and how to be invisible when necessary.

BackstoryDef.title: Priest's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised by a healer of the Nine Divines, tending to the poor and the sick from an early age. [PAWN_pronoun] learned compassion and field medicine simultaneously, and came to understand that faith without service was merely performance.

BackstoryDef.title: Shepherd child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] tended flocks on the rolling plains of western Cyrodiil under skies that went on forever. [PAWN_pronoun] spent long days alone with only animals for company, which suited [PAWN_objective] fine. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up independent and unhurried.

BackstoryDef.title: Wayshrine keeper's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up alongside [PAWN_possessive] parent who maintained a wayshrine along one of Cyrodiil's sacred roads. [PAWN_pronoun] spoke with pilgrims from across Tamriel, heard their stories, and learned that the world was far larger and stranger than any map suggested.

BackstoryDef.title: Courier's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] accompanied [PAWN_possessive] parent on message routes between Imperial cities, learning every road, pass, and shortcut in Cyrodiil before [PAWN_pronoun] was fully grown. [PAWN_pronoun] thought of the entire province as [PAWN_possessive] backyard.

BackstoryDef.title: Engineer's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up watching [PAWN_possessive] parent design siege equipment and fortifications for the Imperial Legion. [PAWN_pronoun] understood how to build things to last and how to tear them down just as quickly.

BackstoryDef.title: Council clerk's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in the Administrative Quarter of the Imperial City, [PAWN_possessive] parent a clerk to the Elder Council. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up surrounded by power [PAWN_pronoun] was never meant to hold, and learned that the people who wrote the records shaped history as much as those who made it.

BackstoryDef.title: Pit fighter's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised by a veteran Arena combatant in the slums adjacent to the Imperial Arena District. [PAWN_possessive] childhood was full of bruises and lessons about pain. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to fight before [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read.

BackstoryDef.title: Fishmonger's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up working the morning markets of a lakeside Imperial town, hauling catch, gutting fish, and calling prices before the sun was properly up. [PAWN_pronoun] developed a salesperson's tongue and a laborer's back.

BackstoryDef.title: Mill child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up working the grain mill that supplied bread to [PAWN_possessive] farming community. Steady, repetitive effort was not a burden but a comfort. [PAWN_pronoun] learned that reliable people were rarer and more valuable than clever ones.

BackstoryDef.title: Highwayman's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born outside the law, raised by a parent who robbed Imperial couriers on the back roads of Colovia. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up knowing how to survive without permission, and how to read a road for ambush and escape in equal measure.

BackstoryDef.title: Blades watch-child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was the child of a Blades operative stationed at a remote inn on the road network. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up watching strangers, learning to remember faces, and understanding that everything had a double meaning. [PAWN_pronoun] never asked questions aloud that [PAWN_pronoun] had already answered silently.

BackstoryDef.title: Palace servant's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the servants' quarters of the White-Gold Tower, invisible to the Emperor but present for everything. [PAWN_pronoun] learned the layout of power by proximity, and understood that those who served the throne saw it more clearly than those who sat upon it.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion orphan
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lost [PAWN_possessive] parents to a border campaign and was raised collectively by the surviving members of [PAWN_possessive] parent's Legion century. [PAWN_pronoun] became the unit mascot, then its errand-runner, then its youngest recruit.

BackstoryDef.title: Inn child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in [PAWN_possessive] family's roadside inn, pouring drinks and hauling firewood for travelers from across Tamriel. [PAWN_pronoun] heard a thousand stories and learned that most people, when properly fed and warm, were willing to say far more than they intended.

BackstoryDef.title: Vintner's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up amid grapevines on a Colovian hillside, helping crush harvest and bottle the wine that graced noble tables across the Empire. [PAWN_pronoun] learned patience, the measure of quality, and how much a bottle was worth to the right buyer.

BackstoryDef.title: Lumber child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised among the logging camps of the Great Forest, helping fell timber that built Imperial forts and bridges. [PAWN_pronoun] grew up strong, practical, and deeply familiar with the patience required to bring something large down cleanly.

BackstoryDef.title: Tax collector's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] accompanied [PAWN_possessive] parent on Imperial tax collection rounds through Cyrodiil's counties. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to assess wealth by sight, to be firm without being cruel, and that the law was only as effective as its enforcement.

BackstoryDef.title: Herder child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth moving cattle across the open pastures of western Cyrodiil, sleeping under stars and living weeks at a time without seeing a building larger than a barn. [PAWN_pronoun] needs few comforts and asks for fewer.

BackstoryDef.title: Guild apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was bound as an apprentice to a Nibenean craftsmen's guild at age eight. [PAWN_pronoun] swept floors, fetched materials, and watched masters work, slowly learning what no book could fully convey. By the time [PAWN_pronoun] was grown, [PAWN_possessive] hands knew more than [PAWN_possessive] head.

BackstoryDef.title: Monastery child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a closed religious community dedicated to one of the Nine Divines, learning liturgy, gardening, healing, and the value of quiet. [PAWN_pronoun] left [PAWN_possessive] walls eventually, but never fully lost the monastery's rhythms.

BackstoryDef.title: Tannery child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up working alongside [PAWN_possessive] family in a Colovian tannery, curing hides and supplying leather to saddle-makers and armorers. The work was hard and unpleasant in warm weather. [PAWN_pronoun] did it anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: Boat child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up aboard a family barge plying the Niben River, spending [PAWN_possessive] childhood on moving water. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to navigate by stars and current, and found dry land vaguely unsatisfying by comparison.

BackstoryDef.title: Market child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood in the great market of the Imperial City, working stalls and running change. [PAWN_pronoun] learned merchant arithmetic before academic numbers and social reading before letters. Commerce was [PAWN_possessive] first language.

BackstoryDef.title: Quarry child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up alongside a working stone quarry in the Colovian hills, hauling rubble and watching skilled cutters shape the raw material of the Empire. [PAWN_pronoun] developed early an appreciation for how long good things take to build properly.

BackstoryDef.title: Tailor's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised in a Nibenean tailor's workshop, threading needles before [PAWN_pronoun] was tall enough to reach the counter. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to read quality in fabric and cut before [PAWN_pronoun] understood the difference between what things were worth and what they cost.

BackstoryDef.title: Ferry child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the river crossings with [PAWN_possessive] family, helping pole travelers across the Niben's tributaries. [PAWN_pronoun] met more strangers in [PAWN_possessive] first ten years than most people encountered in a lifetime and learned that none of them were quite what they appeared.

BackstoryDef.title: Charcoal burner's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the forest clearings of Colovia where [PAWN_possessive] family tended slow-burning charcoal kilns for weeks at a time. The isolation was total and the work was constant. [PAWN_pronoun] learned patience and self-sufficiency in equal, very large measures.

BackstoryDef.title: Fence's child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised by a parent who quietly moved stolen goods through a legitimate-looking shop front. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to keep accounts, keep quiet, and tell the difference between someone who was buying and someone who was scouting. The line was thin and crossing it was expensive.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial Legionnaire
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the Imperial Legion, the most disciplined fighting force in all of Tamriel. Years of marching, drilling, and frontier campaigns honed [PAWN_objective] into a reliable and deadly soldier.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial Legatus
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rose through the ranks of the Imperial Legion to command a cohort. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to balance battlefield authority with the political realities of Imperial governance, earning the respect of soldiers and senators alike.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a trading post along the Gold Road, dealing in goods from every corner of Tamriel. [PAWN_pronoun] had a talent for knowing what people wanted before they asked, and what things were worth before anyone named a price.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial diplomat
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served the Elder Council as an ambassador to foreign courts. [PAWN_pronoun] spent years brokering alliances, defusing crises, and sitting across the table from people who wanted [PAWN_objective] dead. [PAWN_pronoun] never lost a negotiation.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial scholar
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] studied at the Arcane University or one of the great libraries of the Imperial City, dedicating [PAWN_possessive] life to the accumulation and organization of knowledge. [PAWN_pronoun] could recite eras of history and synthesize alchemical compounds in equal measure.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial Battlemage
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the Imperial Battlemage corps, augmenting Legion campaigns with arcane firepower. The dual demands of scholarship and soldiery left [PAWN_objective] with few equals in either field and fewer peers in both.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial farmer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked the estates of western Cyrodiil, growing the grain that fed the Legion's campaigns. Hard country bred hard people - [PAWN_pronoun] knew the land intimately, its seasons, its soil, its animals, and asked for nothing in return except a fair harvest.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion auxiliary scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rode ahead of Legion columns as a light cavalry scout, mapping terrain and reporting enemy positions. [PAWN_pronoun] spent more nights in the open than under a roof and trusted [PAWN_possessive] horse more than most people.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion siege engineer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed and operated siege equipment for the Imperial Legion, bringing down walls and building them back up on Imperial terms. [PAWN_pronoun] approached warfare as a logistical problem.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion field medic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a combat medic attached to a Legion cohort, treating wounds under fire while everyone else was trying to create them. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to work fast, stay calm, and triage without emotion.

BackstoryDef.title: Praetorian guard
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the personal guard of a senior Imperial official, selected from the Legion's finest on the basis of record and temperament. [PAWN_pronoun] stood watch over power and learned to read a room for threat before anything else.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion quartermaster
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed supply chains for a Legion cohort, ensuring that food, equipment, and coin reached the front in right measure at the right time. [PAWN_pronoun] understood that most battles were decided in the logistics tent long before the fighting started.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial fort commander
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commanded a border fortress for the Imperial Legion, responsible for garrison readiness, local security, and the welfare of the territory under [PAWN_possessive] watch. The responsibility suited [PAWN_objective].

BackstoryDef.title: Legion chaplain
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a priest of the Nine Divines attached to a Legion cohort, officiating over prayer, burial, and the small rites that kept soldiers sane on long campaigns. [PAWN_pronoun] carried a sword but preferred words.

BackstoryDef.title: Arena Grand Champion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] rose through every class of the Imperial Arena to claim the title of Grand Champion. The crowd loved [PAWN_objective]. The other gladiators respected and feared [PAWN_objective]. [PAWN_pronoun] learned that celebrity and danger were the same thing wearing different armor.

BackstoryDef.title: Blades agent
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] operated as a field agent of the Blades, the Emperor's intelligence service, embedded in foreign courts under assumed identities. [PAWN_pronoun] gathered information, eliminated threats, and asked no questions that weren't strictly necessary.

BackstoryDef.title: Blades commander
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] commanded a Blades garrison at a remote bastion, responsible for the training and deployment of operatives across an entire region. [PAWN_pronoun] ran [PAWN_possessive] agents like a general and [PAWN_possessive] household like a monastery.

BackstoryDef.title: Blades archivist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed the Blades' intelligence archive, processing field reports, maintaining dossiers, and identifying patterns that individual agents couldn't see from the field. [PAWN_pronoun] knew more secrets than anyone and said less than most.

BackstoryDef.title: Blades combat trainer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] career preparing new Blades recruits for field work, drilling them in swordsmanship, disguise, and tradecraft. [PAWN_pronoun] could see a fight's outcome in the first second and spent the rest of [PAWN_possessive] life teaching others to see the same.

BackstoryDef.title: Palace chamberlain
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as chamberlain to the Emperor's household, overseeing the administrative and domestic operations of the White-Gold Tower. [PAWN_pronoun] managed hundreds of staff, enormous budgets, and the private moods of the most powerful person in Tamriel.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial spymaster
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a senior intelligence official of the Empire, directing networks of agents across Tamriel in service of the Emperors will. [PAWN_pronoun] was never in a room by accident and never said anything without purpose.

BackstoryDef.title: Emperor's advisor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] sat at the Emperor's right hand during the great councils, offering counsel that shaped policy across Tamriel. [PAWN_pronoun] held no title of conquest but wielded influence that outlasted most armies. [PAWN_pronoun] chose words with the precision of a surgeon.

BackstoryDef.title: Elder Council senator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held a seat on the Elder Council, the great deliberative body of the Empire. [PAWN_pronoun] navigated faction warfare, forged coalitions, and occasionally did what was right when the opportunity arose. [PAWN_pronoun] rarely trusted anyone entirely, including [PAWN_possessive]self.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial Legate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was appointed Legate of a frontier province, serving as the Emperor's personal representative with authority over civil governance and Legion forces alike. [PAWN_pronoun] held that authority with both hands and the weight of it shaped [PAWN_objective] permanently.

BackstoryDef.title: Emperor of Anvil
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a Colovian soldier who climbed the Legion's ranks on skill, charm and a real head for logistics, then appointed [PAWN_objective]self Emperor of Anvil. Anvil has not been told. Neither has the actual Emperor. The crown, the court and the provinces exist only in [PAWN_possessive] head, and [PAWN_pronoun] now wanders the frontier as a knight errant, issuing decrees to anyone who will stand still. [PAWN_pronoun] considers mopping floors and dressing wounds to be work for lesser subjects.

BackstoryDef.title: Mages Guild conjurer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] attained the rank of Conjurer within the Mages Guild, specializing in the summoning and binding of Daedric entities to practical purpose. [PAWN_pronoun] treated the work with clinical precision and considerable caution.

BackstoryDef.title: Warlock of the Arcane University
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] achieved the rank of Warlock at the Arcane University after years of study that made [PAWN_possessive] social life nonexistent and [PAWN_possessive] knowledge of destruction magic unmatched. [PAWN_pronoun] was tolerated rather than liked by [PAWN_possessive] peers.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] operated a respected apothecary in a major Nibenean city, refining potions that found their way into Legion medical kits and noble pantries alike. [PAWN_pronoun] never had a formula [PAWN_pronoun] couldn't improve with another hour of work.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial enchanter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] specialized in the binding of magical properties to tools and weapons, a craft that demanded both arcane knowledge and the patience of a master craftsman. [PAWN_pronoun] charged well for [PAWN_possessive] work and delivered everything promised.

BackstoryDef.title: Restoration healer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dedicated [PAWN_possessive] life to the school of Restoration, serving as a healer at temples and military hospitals across Cyrodiil. [PAWN_pronoun] believed that magic's highest purpose was mending what violence broke.

BackstoryDef.title: Nibenean mystic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] retreated from civic life and devoted [PAWN_possessive]self to esoteric study in one of the more reclusive Nibenean traditions, emerging periodically with insights that others found either profound or unsettling, rarely both.

BackstoryDef.title: Count of Cyrodiil
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] held the title of Count over one of Cyrodiil's eight counties, governing thousands of subjects and answering only to the Emperor. [PAWN_pronoun] learned that ruling was less about power than about managing people who each believed they deserved more of it.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial magistrate
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] presided over Imperial courts in a major Cyrodiilian city, adjudicating disputes, condemning criminals, and occasionally having to explain to very powerful people why the law applied to them as well. [PAWN_pronoun] was rarely popular and always right.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial administrator
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served as a senior administrator within the Imperial civil service, managing taxation, law enforcement, and infrastructure development across a county. [PAWN_pronoun] processed more reports in a decade than most people read in a lifetime.

BackstoryDef.title: Caravan master
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] led long-haul trade expeditions across Cyrodiil and beyond, managing guards, merchants, and animals across hundreds of miles of dangerous road. [PAWN_pronoun] knew the price of everything and the risk of everything else.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial banker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] managed a house of accounts in the Imperial City's commercial quarter, extending credit to nobles, merchants, and the Legion alike. [PAWN_pronoun] understood that money was not wealth but merely a representation of trust, and acted accordingly.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial jeweler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] crafted ornamental goods for the Imperial nobility, working in gold, silver, and precious stones sourced from across Tamriel. [PAWN_pronoun] had steady hands, a sharp eye, and no patience whatsoever for imprecision.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial spice trader
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built a modest fortune dealing in exotic spices and alchemical ingredients imported from Elsweyr and beyond. [PAWN_pronoun] knew when a shipment was real and when it wasn't, and which contacts to trust and which to carry a blade around.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian armorer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] operated a weapons and armor forge in a Colovian city, supplying Legion equipment under contract. [PAWN_pronoun] took pride in every piece and could tell a blade's quality blindfolded by its balance alone.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial innkeeper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a roadside inn on one of Cyrodiil's major trade routes, feeding and housing an endless stream of travelers. [PAWN_pronoun] knew everyone's business within a week of their arrival and most of Tamriel's news before it reached the capital.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion veteran
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served [PAWN_possessive] full term in the Imperial Legion and came home with a modest pension and a lifetime of hard experience. [PAWN_pronoun] was done with war but not with discipline, and [PAWN_pronoun] kept both.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial road warden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] patrolled the Imperial road network, protecting travelers from bandits, clearing obstacles, and reporting road damage to the civil engineers. [PAWN_pronoun] walked more miles than most people dreamed of covering and knew every wayshrine in Cyrodiil by heart.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial architect
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed public buildings, roads, and aqueducts for the Imperial civil service, working to bring the Empire's distinctive Romanesque order to the far corners of Cyrodiil. [PAWN_pronoun] counted [PAWN_possessive] best work in structures that would outlast [PAWN_objective] by centuries.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial physician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] practiced medicine in a major Imperial city, attending to patients ranging from dockworkers to minor nobles. [PAWN_pronoun] believed in evidence, observation, and the occasional course of treatment that required a patient to simply rest and stop making things worse.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a professional hunter, supplying game to markets and noble estates across Cyrodiil. [PAWN_pronoun] knew the Great Forest's geography better than most maps and could track a wounded animal for two days without sleep.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial chronicler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] career documenting the history of the Third Era, traveling to battlefields, courts, and ruins to gather primary accounts. [PAWN_pronoun] believed the truth mattered even when it was inconvenient, which was most of the time.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial prison warden
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] oversaw the Imperial Prison, the Empire's most secure holding facility, managing everything from petty thieves to political prisoners. [PAWN_pronoun] took the work seriously and personally, which made [PAWN_objective] very good at it and not particularly pleasant company.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian rancher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a large cattle operation in western Cyrodiil, managing land, workers, and livestock through droughts, raids, and Legion requisitioning. [PAWN_pronoun] kept the ranch going through stubbornness that bordered on the remarkable.

BackstoryDef.title: Temple priest
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served the Nine Divines as an ordained priest, ministering to a congregation in a Cyrodiilian city. [PAWN_pronoun] heard confessions, administered last rites, and spent considerable energy convincing people to make better choices before it came to that.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial courier
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried sealed dispatches for the Imperial administrative network, crossing Cyrodiil at all hours regardless of weather, season, or the various threats that loitered alongside the roads. [PAWN_pronoun] delivered everything on time and intact.

BackstoryDef.title: Nibenean herbalist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] gathered and sold medicinal herbs from the forests and swamps of the Nibenay Basin, supplying apothecaries and healers across the region. [PAWN_pronoun] knew which plants cured and which killed and treated both with equal respect.

BackstoryDef.title: Gladiator instructor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] trained new Arena recruits, drilling their footwork, conditioning their bodies, and breaking down their bad habits with the blunt efficiency of someone who had survived the Arena floor. [PAWN_pronoun] had bled for the crowd and had no desire to do so again.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial sailor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] crewed Imperial vessels across the inland waterways and coastal routes of Cyrodiil, transporting goods and troops to wherever the Emperor needed them. [PAWN_pronoun] trusted the current, distrusted overland routes, and smelled faintly of river water no matter how long [PAWN_pronoun] spent ashore.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian blacksmith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] operated a smithy in a Colovian town, forging tools, blades, and horseshoes for the community and occasional weapons orders from the Legion. [PAWN_pronoun] worked dawn to dusk and took pride in a clean edge and honest price.

BackstoryDef.title: Legion drill sergeant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent twenty years making raw recruits into Imperial Legionnaires, a task that required equal parts patience, volume, and willingness to demonstrate the correct technique personally. [PAWN_pronoun] built soldiers the Empire trusted with its borders.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial surveyor
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] charted land and planned infrastructure for the Imperial civil service, spending months in remote terrain to measure, record, and report. [PAWN_pronoun] was precise, meticulous, and entirely comfortable working alone in wilderness for extended periods.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial court chef
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in the kitchens of a Count's hall, producing elaborate feasts for political events that required as much diplomacy as culinary skill. [PAWN_pronoun] knew that a bad meal could end a negotiation faster than a bad deal.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian woodsman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a timber cutter, ranger, and pest controller in the forestlands of western Cyrodiil. [PAWN_pronoun] felled trees, managed wildlife, and kept the lumber contracts that built half the Empire flowing reliably. Words were for people who didn't know how to work.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial notary
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] career authenticating deeds, contracts, and inheritance claims for the Imperial civil service. [PAWN_pronoun] had witnessed more human drama across a desk than most people experienced in a lifetime, and remained professionally impassive throughout all of it.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial tax collector
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] collected Imperial levies across a rural county, a role that required firmness, tact, and the ability to count under considerable social pressure. [PAWN_pronoun] was never the most popular person in any room but always among the most necessary.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial carpenter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked as a master carpenter, building furniture, fixtures, and structural woodwork for civic and noble commissions across Cyrodiil. [PAWN_pronoun] took no shortcuts and returned every piece that wasn't right, which was almost never.

BackstoryDef.title: Nibenean potter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] produced fine ceramic goods in the Nibenean craft tradition, working clay into vessels and decorative pieces prized across Cyrodiil. [PAWN_pronoun] sold [PAWN_possessive] work at market and had a habit of giving pieces away to people who struck [PAWN_objective] as needing something beautiful.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian hedge knight
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a landless warrior-for-hire operating in the Colovian territories, taking contracts from minor lords and merchants who needed problems solved discreetly. [PAWN_pronoun] was not picky about the work and quite selective about the company.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial librarian
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] maintained one of the Imperial City's great libraries, preserving texts, cataloguing holdings, and managing the scholars who believed that wanting access to a restricted volume entitled them to it. [PAWN_pronoun] was consistent, which they found less charming than [PAWN_pronoun] did.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian horse breeder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] bred and trained horses for the Imperial Legion's cavalry units, developing lines for endurance, temperament, and battlefield composure. [PAWN_pronoun] understood animals better than most people and cared for them accordingly.

BackstoryDef.title: Nibenean weaver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] wove cloth and tapestries in the Nibenean tradition, producing goods that ranged from workman's canvas to decorative pieces that graced noble halls. [PAWN_pronoun] found weaving meditative and customers exasperating, in roughly equal measure.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian mine foreman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] oversaw operations at a silver or iron mine in the Colovian Highlands, managing workers, safety, equipment, and production quotas under the ever-present eyes of an Imperial mining contract. [PAWN_pronoun] kept the ore moving and the workers alive.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial funeral director
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] oversaw the burial rites of a major Cyrodiilian city, coordinating between the temples and the bereaved to ensure the dead were honored according to the rites of the Nine Divines. [PAWN_pronoun] was matter-of-fact about death in a way that survivors often found oddly comforting.

BackstoryDef.title: Imperial entertainer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] performed in the taverns, plazas, and noble halls of the Imperial City as a singer, storyteller, and occasional comedic act. [PAWN_pronoun] understood audiences better than most scholars understood texts, and knew that people rarely wanted truth they wanted something that felt like it.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian militiaman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in a local Colovian town militia, providing security between Legion patrols and handling the threats too small for the Empire to formally bother with. [PAWN_pronoun] was practical, not heroic, and proud of the distinction.

BackstoryDef.title: Nibenean silk merchant
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] imported and sold fine silk through contacts stretching from Elsweyr to the Imperial City, a trade that required a network of trust, a talent for valuation, and the patience to wait for the right buyer. [PAWN_pronoun] never undersold and never rushed.

BackstoryDef.title: Colovian frontier settler
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] established a homestead on the edges of formally patrolled Imperial territory, building shelter, clearing land, and defending it without the convenience of nearby reinforcement. [PAWN_pronoun] asked for no help and was quietly grateful when it arrived anyway.
